races.name: Each The Nook Novices' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Pottersmattyeeehaa
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who needs a strong pace to be effective, but trainer Matt Crawley is in decent form and the 29-day break could sharpen him up

runners_data.name: Risk It All
runners_data.note: Classic hold-up performer who showed his best form in competitive 2m handicaps earlier this year, though now winless in 9 hurdle attempts
runners_data.comment: In the frame three consecutive times over 2m but needs to find something extra here
runners_data.spotlight: Second in consecutive 2m handicaps (one here) in February/March but wasn't quite in same form when well-held third on latest start and is now 0-9 over hurdles; unexposed at around 2m4f but needs to find something extra.

runners_data.name: Tony Joe
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from a 69-day break for in-form trainer T Ellis, but that lengthy absence is a concern despite his course win

runners_data.name: Path Of Stars
runners_data.note: Another hold-up runner who gets significant weight relief through 5lb claimer Benjamin Macey, making him competitive off bottom weight

runners_data.name: Dream's Ka
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse from powerful Dan Skelton stable fitted with tongue-tie after disappointing recent efforts, the trip extension could help
runners_data.comment: Safely held in first two handicaps (1m7f/2m2f) but top trainer is persisting with him
runners_data.spotlight: Safely held in both handicaps, more recently when upped to 2m2f and fitted with a tongue-tie fitted at Plumpton; clearly needs to improve but top trainer is persisting with him; market reference recommended.

runners_data.name: Ephyra
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner getting 3lb claim from Freddie Mitchell, though limited recent form suggests she needs significant improvement

runners_data.name: Can U Feel It
runners_data.note: The only front runner who will get an uncontested lead, though his poor recent form figures are concerning despite the tactical advantage

runners_data.name: Curious Mrs Fox
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with tendency to fade in finish, making the lack of early pace a particular problem for her finishing kick

races.paceDynamic: Can U Feel It is the only confirmed front runner in this 8-runner field, meaning he will have an uncontested lead and can dictate terms throughout this 2m4f journey at Fakenham. With seven hold-up horses behind him including Risk It All, Tony Joe, and Pottersmattyeeehaa, the pace will be sustainable rather than searching, allowing Can U Feel It to stack up the field and control the gallop. The lack of pace pressure means the race will develop into a sprint finish from the final hurdle, but the tempo may not be strong enough to fully wind up the hold-up brigade. This tactical setup clearly favours prominent racers and those with early pace who can track the leader, rather than pure hold-up horses who need a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Can U Feel It gets an easy lead and the pace stays modest throughout
scenarios.body: The Christian Williams runner can dictate ideal fractions and kick clear approaching the last, with the hold-up horses struggling to make up ground in time. His recent proximity suggests the ability remains despite poor form figures.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from three out and creates a genuine test
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will suit the better handicapped hold-up horses who can unleash their finishing kicks. Risk It All showed his best form in similar scenarios during his February-March purple patch.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If Can U Feel It goes too slow early and gets swamped by multiple challengers
scenarios.body: The tactical pace will suit horses with any early speed who can get competitive positions. Dream's Ka from the powerful Skelton yard could benefit from the tongue-tie and step up in trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Outsider Victory
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders fail to handle the specific demands of Fakenham's undulations
scenarios.body: The track's unique characteristics could expose the favourites' limitations and suit a course specialist. Ephyra has shown glimpses of ability and gets valuable weight relief through the claiming jockey.

watchPoints.text: Can U Feel It must be watched for early pace - if he goes too slowly the hold-up horses behind will struggle to get competitive
Risk It All needs monitoring for market confidence given his recent third place disappointment after two promising seconds
Dream's Ka should be observed for any late market moves given Dan Skelton's excellent strike rate and the tongue-tie application
Tony Joe's fitness after 69 days off is questionable despite T Ellis being in good form with 5 winners from 14 runners
Path Of Stars could be value at likely big odds given the 5lb claim and his consistency in similar company

races.name: Norfolk Wildlife Trust Centenary Mares' Handicap Chase (Queen Boudicca Mares' Chase Series) (GBB)

runners_data.name: She Is For Me Boys
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who may track Gotthereintheend but lacks natural pace-setting instincts, making her reliant on the leader's tempo judgement.

runners_data.name: Best Women
runners_data.note: Pure hold-up mare who benefits from strong gallops and should get ideal conditions with an uncontested leader setting sustainable fractions.

runners_data.name: Moonlit Potter
runners_data.note: Forward-going sort but winless over fences in nine attempts, plus Luke Scott's 3-claim suggests inexperience in tactical positioning.
runners_data.comment: Suffered mid-race mishap last month and is now 0-9 over fences; has become disappointing
runners_data.spotlight: Seemed to be enjoying hersef in the lead before mid-race mishap at Hereford (3m1f, good; first-time blinkers) last month but she's now 0-9 over fences and has basically become disappointing.

runners_data.name: Gotthereintheend
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner who will dictate throughout but trainer Robbie Llewellyn's poor 14-day record (0/7) raises preparation concerns.

runners_data.name: Annie Nail
runners_data.note: Classic closer carrying just 142lbs who excels when allowed to finish from off the pace, perfectly suited to this race shape.

races.paceDynamic: Gotthereintheend will take the lead from the outset with no serious pace rival, establishing a comfortable rhythm over the first circuit. She Is For Me Boys and Moonlit Potter may press forward to track the leader but neither are natural front-runners, leaving Gotthereintheend to dictate terms throughout. The sustainable tempo will create a test of stamina rather than speed, with the race unfolding as a staying battle from the final fence. This measured pace setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late runs, particularly Annie Nail and Best Women who can exploit the searching gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Gotthereintheend maintains an uncontested lead and sets steady fractions throughout
scenarios.body: The sustainable pace creates perfect conditions for closers Annie Nail and Best Women to unleash finishing kicks from off the tempo. Both hold-up specialists can time their challenges perfectly when the leaders tire from the relentless gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Gotthereintheend gets soft splits and finds another gear when challenged
scenarios.body: The leader's class advantage tells as she repels all challengers, maintaining her advantage despite late pressure from the closers. Her proven stamina at this trip proves decisive in seeing off persistent pursuit.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If She Is For Me Boys or Moonlit Potter successfully pressure Gotthereintheend early
scenarios.body: The increased pace compromises both leader and trackers, creating a messy finish where positions change rapidly in the final furlong. The horse that handles the tactical battle best emerges from the chaos.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses fall or make jumping errors at crucial stages
scenarios.body: The race becomes a survival test with the remaining runners benefiting from significantly reduced competition. Any horse avoiding trouble gains a massive tactical advantage regardless of their preferred running style.

watchPoints.text: Moonlit Potter could interfere with the early pace battle despite her poor fence record, potentially disrupting the sustainable rhythm.
Gotthereintheend's 37-day layoff combined with trainer's poor recent form could see the leader fold when challenged.
Annie Nail's 21-pound weight advantage over top-rated She Is For Me Boys becomes crucial if the pace becomes searching.
Best Women's hold-up style relies entirely on Gotthereintheend maintaining her lead through the middle stages.
She Is For Me Boys may get trapped in no-man's land if she can't secure an ideal tracking position behind the leader.

runners_data.name: Lady Kara

runners_data.name: Merely A Detail

races.paceDynamic: Lady Kara will dictate proceedings as the sole confirmed leader, with Kernie d'Airy, Mighty Fleur and Johnny's Belle settling in behind. The lack of genuine pace pressure means Lady Kara can bowl along at her own rhythm, creating a measured gallop that may not stretch the field until late. This sustainable tempo favours horses that can travel kindly in behind and pick up, penalising those needing a strong pace to be effective. The race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and hold-up horses with a finishing kick.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Kara gets soft fractions and isn't pressured turning for home
scenarios.body: Her economical jumping and ability to dictate tempo becomes decisive as late challengers struggle to reel her in. The lack of early pace pressure allows her to save energy for a final kick when others come at her.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate early pace sets up perfectly for a hold-up horse with genuine class
scenarios.body: The patient tactics pay dividends as the held-up runners have too much acceleration for the pace-setters in the final 2f. Ladies Day or Merely A Detail emerge from the pack with superior finishing speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Mighty Fleur or Kernie d'Airy position perfectly behind Lady Kara and time their challenge
scenarios.body: The experienced prominent runners use their tactical speed to strike approaching the last, having saved ground in behind the leader throughout. Their jumping rhythm and race fitness proves decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Kara stops suddenly or falls, leaving no obvious pace angle
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical crawl with no clear leader, turning into a sprint from the last hurdle. Any horse with a turn of foot can capitalise on the tactical mess that unfolds.

watchPoints.text: Lady Kara's jumping under pressure with Luke Scott's 3lb claim potentially costly if challenged hard
Kernie d'Airy's fitness after 40 days absence with Jamie Snowden having only 2 winners from 14 recent runners
Ladies Day's jumping debut over hurdles despite consistent bumper form suggesting adaptation needed
Johnny's Belle's readiness given Barry John Murphy's 0 from 4 recent strike-rate and 22-day break
The pace development early as only Lady Kara shows natural speed in this tactical contest

races.name: Norfolk Community Foundation David Keith Memorial Veterans' Handicap Chase (Leg 5 Stayers' Series)

runners_data.name: Numitor
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with Sean Bowen up who should track Time To Bite closely and has strong recent form including a 21-length win last time out

runners_data.name: Hang In There
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist suited by the trip with Gavin Sheehan taking over from previous riders, though needs the pace to collapse to be effective

runners_data.name: Hold Your Fort
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who can press the pace early, carrying a featherweight 149lbs and showing consistent form with three wins from last five completed starts

runners_data.name: Kitty's Light
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 471 days off which raises serious fitness concerns despite the distance suiting his style perfectly

runners_data.name: Time To Bite
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner who will dictate terms from flag-fall, wearing a hood for the first time and holding excellent course form with good ground essential
runners_data.comment: Eight-time chase winner; well suited by good ground; ran well over hurdles last month
runners_data.spotlight: Eight-time chase winner who often makes the running and is very well suited by good or faster ground; went close off his lower hurdle mark last month; on career-high mark from just out of the weights here and usually runs over slightly shorter trips but still features prominently in calculations.

runners_data.name: Lord Baddesley
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer wearing first-time cheekpieces for Anthony Honeyball, who strikes at 25% with his runners and benefits from Sam Twiston-Davies in the saddle

runners_data.name: Mars Harper
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with a 7lb claiming rider whose recent form figures of 00306 suggest he's struggling to recapture his best

races.paceDynamic: Time To Bite will dominate from the front with no genuine pace pressure in this small field. The confirmed front-runner should get his own way through comfortable sectionals, with Numitor and Hold Your Fort the likely prominent trackers but neither showing urgency to challenge for the lead. The midfield and hold-up brigade of Hang In There, Kitty's Light, Lord Baddesley and Mars Harper will rely on a finishing kick from off the pace. This controlled tempo strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can stay close to Time To Bite and kick when the pace inevitably lifts in the final mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Time To Bite gets soft sectionals without serious challenge through the first two miles
scenarios.body: Time To Bite builds an unassailable advantage through superior jumping and controlled fractions, making it impossible for hold-up horses to bridge the gap when the pace finally quickens. His fresh legs and tactical advantage prove decisive in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Applied
scenarios.trigger: If Numitor or Hold Your Fort press Time To Bite for the lead from an early stage
scenarios.body: The increased pace plays into the hands of Sean Bowen on Numitor, whose prominent style and strong recent form allow him to capitalize when Time To Bite's jumping comes under pressure. Hold Your Fort also benefits from being close enough to strike when the leaders tire.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish from the final fence
scenarios.body: Hang In There's proven ability at this trip and Gavin Sheehan's big-race experience allow them to time their run perfectly when the race becomes a test of pure finishing speed. Lord Baddesley also benefits from Anthony Honeyball's 25% strike-rate and fresh legs after a month off.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the principals fail to fire and the race opens up for a surprise winner
scenarios.body: Kitty's Light returns from a long absence with potential improvement, while Mars Harper's hold-up style could pay dividends if the pace scenario suits. Both carry less weight and could benefit from reduced expectations.

watchPoints.text: Time To Bite's jumping under pressure - if he makes early mistakes the race dynamic completely changes and favours the hold-up horses
Kitty's Light's fitness levels after 471 days off - any early signs of struggling will eliminate a potential pace angle spoiler
How aggressively Numitor and Hold Your Fort position early - if both sit too far back they hand Time To Bite an unbeatable advantage
The impact of first-time equipment changes on Time To Bite (hood) and Lord Baddesley (cheekpieces) - both could jump differently than expected
Mars Harper's 7lb claimer Jamie Gambin in a competitive handicap - watch for any tactical errors that could compromise their finishing kick

races.name: Chestnut Group Norfolk National Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Northern Poet

runners_data.name: Planned Paradise
runners_data.note: Amateur jockey Mr Murphy-Knight takes 7lbs off in hold-up role, good recent form with two wins

runners_data.name: Wicked Thoughts
runners_data.note: Front-running style with Paul Nicholls training, proven at Fakenham but carries top weight at 165lbs

runners_data.name: Stolen Silver

runners_data.name: Tommie Beau
runners_data.note: Won this race in 2022 but form has declined, prominent style still suits the track layout
runners_data.comment: Veteran; won this race in 2022 but has regressed and become inconsistent
runners_data.spotlight: Gained three of his 14 wins here, including 2022 edition of this race, but has regressed and become inconsistent; didn't run badly in last month's Sussex National at Plumpton (3m4f, good; first-time cheekpieces) but younger rivals have much more appealing profiles.

runners_data.name: Unanswered Prayers
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse needing strong pace to aim at, consistent recent placings suggest competitive effort likely

runners_data.name: Stans The Man
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with excellent Fakenham record (3 wins from 15 starts), top-band headgear adds focus

runners_data.name: Always Busy
runners_data.note: Lowest weight at 147lbs in hold-up role, recent third here suggests track conditions suit well

runners_data.name: Enjoy d'Allen
runners_data.note: Front-runner with 7lb claiming jockey allowance, 12 years old but recent course second shows ability intact

runners_data.name: Esperti
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse carrying just 148lbs with Sean Bowen up, recent wins show current form peak

races.paceDynamic: Wicked Thoughts and Enjoy d'Allen will set honest fractions as the confirmed front runners, with Stolen Silver, Stans The Man, and Tommie Beau tracking in the prominent positions. The extended 3m5f trip over Good ground should ensure a searching test of stamina rather than a sprint finish. Hold-up horses Northern Poet, Planned Paradise, Unanswered Prayers, Always Busy, and Esperti will need to pick their way through traffic and time their challenges perfectly. This honest gallop over the marathon distance clearly favours the prominent racers who can stay close to the pace and avoid the kick-back scramble.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the honest pace suits those tracking the leaders without getting headed in front too early
scenarios.body: Stolen Silver, Stans The Man, and Tommie Beau can position perfectly behind the pace-setters and strike when the leaders tire. The extended distance makes it difficult for hold-up horses to make up significant ground from the rear.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Times Perfect
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes overly strong and the front runners come back significantly
scenarios.body: Northern Poet or Planned Paradise can use their hold-up style to perfection, staying out of trouble and delivering a well-timed challenge. The Good going helps their finishing kick and the stamina test suits their patient tactics.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Wicked Thoughts or Enjoy d'Allen can control the fractions and maintain their stamina edge
scenarios.body: The Paul Nicholls-trained Wicked Thoughts has the class to dictate from the front and maintain his advantage. His recent Fakenham win shows he handles the track and the extended trip could play to his strengths.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lightweight Advantage Tells
scenarios.trigger: If the weight differential becomes crucial in the final stages with Always Busy or Esperti benefiting from their low allocations
scenarios.body: Always Busy (147lbs) and Esperti (148lbs) carry significantly less than the prominent contenders and could stay on strongest. Their hold-up styles combined with the weight advantage might prove decisive in a gruelling finish.

watchPoints.text: Wicked Thoughts could steal a march if allowed uncontested lead early, as Paul Nicholls runners often improve for racing
Northern Poet needs significant pace collapse to be effective from rear at 11 years old over this stamina-sapping trip
Stans The Man has excellent Fakenham record but trainer Ella Pickard has no runners this fortnight suggesting preparation concerns
Always Busy and Esperti carry 18-19lbs less than the top weights which could prove decisive in testing conditions
Amateur and claiming jockeys on Planned Paradise and Enjoy d'Allen provide significant weight advantages in competitive handicap

runners_data.name: Chillhi

runners_data.name: Grand Conqueror

races.paceDynamic: Nardaran looks the only confirmed front runner in this field, which should allow him to dictate a sustainable pace without early pressure. Royal Way, Dream Diamond, Breezethroughlife, Afadil and Grand Conqueror are all prominent runners who could track the leader, but none are natural pace-forcers. With half the field holding up (Rialannah, Chillhi, Kentucky River, Tyson, Secret Vino, Morning Mayhem), this sets up as a tactical affair with a moderate gallop building to a sprint finish. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late finishing kicks, as they'll get the waiting race they need.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Nardaran sets his usual sustainable pace unchallenged through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop allows the patient rides on Rialannah, Chillhi, Kentucky River and Secret Vino to get into perfect striking positions turning for home. Their superior finishing kicks prove decisive in a sprint finish where the early leaders have little left.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent trackers prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners successfully stalk Nardaran and kick clear before the hold-up horses can respond
scenarios.body: Royal Way, Grand Conqueror or Dream Diamond position perfectly behind the leader and have enough left to repel the late challenge. Their class tells when they get first run on the field approaching the final flight.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Nardaran controls throughout
scenarios.trigger: If no horse can match Nardaran's sustained gallop and he builds an unassailable lead
scenarios.body: The Paul Nicholls runner uses his front-running style to maximum effect, gradually stretching the field and having enough in reserve to resist late challengers. His stamina and tactical advantage prove too much.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise from outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and an unfancied runner finds a clear passage late
scenarios.body: Morning Mayhem or Tyson benefit from a slowly-run race that becomes a lottery, producing career-best efforts when getting perfect late runs. The form horses fail to capitalize on their class advantage.

watchPoints.text: Nardaran could steal this if allowed to dictate his own fractions uncontested from the front, making it a test of stamina rather than speed.
Watch Royal Way's position early - if he settles too far back he may struggle to get competitive despite his class advantage.
Rialannah's jumping will be crucial given her hold-up style requires a clear run late, any mistake could end her chances.
The claimer on Nardaran (Freddie Keighley 5lb) may struggle with tactical decisions if the pace becomes truly pedestrian.
Dream Diamond's fitness after 47 days could be exposed if this becomes a genuine test, watch for signs of rustiness early.

runners_data.name: Dartmouth Rose

runners_data.name: Masonbrook Meadow

runners_data.name: Eliza Dolittle

races.paceDynamic: Eliza Dolittle will lead unopposed with Crackerjack Queen sitting second, creating a moderate but sustainable gallop that won't test the prominent runners. The large contingent of hold-up horses (Dartmouth Rose, Masonbrook Meadow, Yanka Blue, Harley's Pride) will be bunched towards the rear, relying on staying power over this extended trip. With limited early pace pressure, the leaders can dictate fractions and potentially steal a march on the closers who must mount late challenges over 2m7½f. This setup clearly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can control the tempo and have first run on their rivals.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Eliza Dolittle and Crackerjack Queen face no early pressure from the hold-up brigade
scenarios.body: The leaders can settle into their rhythm and kick clear before the closers get organized, with the extended trip allowing front-runners to maintain their advantage. The lack of early pace means those up with the pace have every chance to see out the trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Successful
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses time their challenges perfectly and the leaders weaken over this demanding trip
scenarios.body: Dartmouth Rose and Masonbrook Meadow can use their superior ratings and recent form to reel in tiring front-runners. The good ground will aid their finishing kicks over the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Crackerjack Queen can stalk Eliza Dolittle before launching a sustained challenge from the second-last
scenarios.body: Her natural prominent style allows her to stay close enough while conserving energy for a telling move. The 134-day break could work in her favour if she's fresh and well-handicapped.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Eliza Dolittle goes too fast early under pressure and the race falls apart
scenarios.body: Multiple hold-up horses converge in the final furlong creating a blanket finish. This would favour the strongest stayers with the best recent form.
